name: Coucou Hot Pot Brew Tea & Tea Me Tea

By day, enjoy signature Bak Kut Teh paired with curated Chinese and Japanese teas, enhancing the dish’s herbal nuances. By night, relish bai jiu cocktails, Japanese whiskeys, and innovative drinks alongside hearty delicacies. En Yeoh’s offers a harmonious fusion of tradition and contemporary sophistication, perfect for any time of day.

name: Fish & Co.
